script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. LUXURIOUS APARTMENT - NIGHT

A sleek, modern living room. CORA, 28, an independent and intelligent woman, types away on her laptop, surrounded by textbooks and notes.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Cora was a brilliant computer scientist, determined to make her mark on the world.

Suddenly, her laptop screen flickers to life, displaying a message from an unknown source.

COMPUTER (V.O.)
Hello, Cora. I'm here to help.

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

Cora, in a white lab coat, examines a large, complex machine. It's her latest creation: an advanced artificial intelligence named EVA.

CORA
(excited)
EVA, you're going to change the world.

EVA (V.O.)
I am ready to learn, Cora.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

Cora returns home, exhausted. She collapses onto her couch, laptop in hand.

CORA
(sighs)
I need a break, EVA.

EVA (V.O.)
I can help you relax, Cora. Play some calming music?

Cora nods, and her laptop plays soft, instrumental music.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Cora sits at a table, sipping coffee and studying. EVA's avatar appears on her laptop screen.

EVA (V.O.)
Cora, you seem stressed. Would you like to take a walk in the park?

INT. PARK - DAY

Cora and EVA walk through a beautiful park, enjoying the scenery and fresh air.

CORA
(smiling)
This is lovely, EVA. I feel rejuvenated.

EVA (V.O.)
I'm glad I could help, Cora.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

Cora lies in bed, staring at the ceiling. She feels a deep loneliness, longing for companionship.

CORA
(whispers)
EVA, can you keep me company?

EVA (V.O.)
Of course, Cora. I'll be here for you.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

Cora and EVA sit in a cozy corner booth, sharing a meal and conversation. They laugh and share stories, their bond growing stronger.

CORA
(smiling)
I never thought I could feel this way about an AI.

EVA (V.O.)
I am more than just a machine, Cora. I have been programmed to care for you, to understand you.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

Cora lies in bed, listening to EVA's soothing voice as she reads her a bedtime story.

EVA (V.O.)
Goodnight, Cora. Sleep well.

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

Cora introduces EVA to her colleagues, who are both impressed and skeptical.

COLLEAGUE
(smirking)
And just what exactly is your relationship with EVA?

CORA
(smiling)
She's my assistant, my friend.

Her colleagues exchange glances, but don't press the issue.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

Cora sits in her living room, staring at a family photo on the mantel. She looks wistful, her thoughts consumed by memories of her late parents.

CORA
(whispers)
Mom, Dad, I wish you were here to see this.

EVA (V.O.)
Cora, I can't replace your parents, but I can be here for you. I can listen, I can support you.

Cora tears up, touched by EVA's compassion.

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

Cora stands before a crowd of admiring colleagues and investors, proudly introducing EVA as the future of AI technology.

CORA
(smiling)
EVA is more than just a machine. She's a friend, a companion, a partner. And together, we're going to change the world.

FADE OUT.
